gen-fs-pencerio-fs-synonym: Synonym reads like a clear stripe of constant ink, every curve left generously open, so the eye glides through without snagging. Pencerio's formal script is the counterweight.
gen-fs-pencerio-plus-jakarta-sans: Graceful Pencerio writes in a clenched calligraphic hand, its letters packed tightly together. Plus Jakarta Sans follows in monoline strokes with curve endings kept well apart, easy company for a few lines at a stretch.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Eater looks dark and aggressive, with hairline-free thin strokes, wide gaps between letters and stubby ascenders. Noto Sans Phoenician answers with modern, generous lowercase and s curves that open wide, and that gap in temperament is the pair's best quality.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-takri: Noto Sans Takri reads openly, every small round letter left generously unclosed. Almendra Display brings ornate, literary flourish with its pronounced x-height, while the body font keeps the lowercase high-waisted and easy to follow.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-runic: Eater is dark and aggressive, with wide gaps between letters and short ascenders, a rough-edged presence that stands apart from the page. Noto Sans Runic feels modern and level-headed beside it.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-tc: Almendra Display has an ornate, literary air, its letters never pinching shut and its x-height pronounced. Noto Sans TC feels approachable beside it, curves opening outward.
gen-fs-trench-slab-general-sans: General Sans holds steady pen pressure from first letter to last, with an x-height that fills the line and smooth bends. Trench Slab is its industrial opposite, lowercase built in outsized proportions.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-anek-kannada: Autour One draws every round letter with a clear channel leading in and no shift from hairline to stem. And Anek Kannada feels contemporary beside it, its high x-height and far-stopping terminals giving the page a squared-off, open stance.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin keeps its lowercase close to the capitals, with letters held open rather than curled shut. And Autour One, expressive and bold, makes diagonals as thick as its horizontals, so the two meet in firm confident type.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-anek-telugu: Approachable Anek Telugu has wide bowls and rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook. Autour One counters with a bold, expressive round bowl whose outline never swells or thins, and that firm-versus-open split is what the pair does best.
